item.title: How to Secure a Python Project Against Supply Chain Attacks: Dependabot, pip-audit, and Branch Protection
item.description: Supply chain attacks like Mini Shai-Hulud hit PyPI in 2026. How to harden a Python project with pinned deps, pip-audit in CI, Dependabot and branch protection.

item.title: Give Claude Code Eyes Inside Your WSL2 Docker Containers
item.description: Stop pasting Docker Compose logs into Claude Code. Give it SSH access into WSL2 so it reads container logs directly, the same trick used with a Kali VM.

item.title: How to force the Windows 11 upgrade
item.description: Force the Windows 11 upgrade on a compatible machine with Microsoft's Installation Assistant instead of waiting for the automatic rollout.

item.title: How to force the Windows 10 20H2 update
item.description: Manually install Windows 10 20H2 using the Microsoft Update Assistant. Bypass the phased rollout of the October 2020 feature update on compatible hardware.

item.title: How to invoke UAC in a Windows Batch script
item.description: Trigger a UAC elevation prompt from a Windows batch script with a VBScript helper, then re-run the original script with administrator rights.

item.title: [FIXED] Bose Bluetooth headphones with Windows 10
item.description: Fix poor Bose Bluetooth audio and the microphone feedback loop on Windows 10 by switching from the generic driver to Microsoft A2DP Source.

item.title: How to force the Windows 10 2004 update
item.description: Force the Windows 10 version 2004 update to install now with Microsoft's Update Assistant instead of waiting for the staggered rollout.

item.title: How to check if RAM is running in ECC mode
item.description: Check whether your RAM is running in ECC mode on Windows and Linux using dmidecode or WMIC, for servers and workstations.

item.title: Adding WMIC command to the Windows path
item.description: Add C:\Windows\System32\wbem to the Windows PATH to restore wmic and fix 'wmic is not recognized' errors on Windows 10 after updates or PATH changes.

item.title: Copy Paste in vSphere before installing VMware tools
item.description: Send text into a vSphere VM before VMware Tools is installed using AutoIT keystrokes, getting round the clipboard limit during fresh OS installs.

item.title: Automatically pause Spotify with the 3CX client
item.description: Automatically pause Spotify when a 3CX VoIP call comes in, using a small AutoIT script that sits in the tray.

item.title: Prevent Screensavers and Lock-screens with Powershell
item.description: Stop the Windows screensaver and lock screen kicking in with a PowerShell SendKeys loop. Keeps a PC awake with a timed keypress and no Group Policy changes.

item.title: How to make a VirtualBox VM the same resolution as host
item.description: Match a VirtualBox VM's resolution to the host display with the VBoxSVGA controller, fullscreen scaling and dynamic resolution adjustment.

item.title: Modifying Windows shortcuts is Powershell
item.description: Recursively update Windows shortcut targets in PowerShell with WScript.Shell. Batch-fix broken .lnk files after moving applications or changing drive letters.
